NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is needed to show old photos taken near you on the map.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Needed to save an old photo, its colorized version or a then-and-now comparison to your gallery.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Gallery access is needed only to save photos you choose to save. The app does not browse your gallery.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access lets you photograph this place today and compare it with the old photo.
